name: Career Crossroads
description: A big opportunity just landed. But every door you open might close another.

chapters.title: The Offer
chapters.description: A music label reached out. They want to sign you. Recording contract. Real money. But there are strings attached.

choices.label: Hear Them Out
choices.description: At least take the meeting. See what they're offering.

choices.label: Decline
choices.description: Battle rap is your lane. You're not trying to be an artist.

choices.label: Use It as Leverage
choices.description: Tell other people about the offer. See if better opportunities come.

chapters.title: The Meeting
chapters.description: They flew you out. Nice offices. The deal is real. But they want exclusive rights. No battles without their approval.

choices.label: Sign the Exclusive Deal
choices.description: Life-changing money. New doors opening. Worth the trade-off.

choices.label: Negotiate Better Terms
choices.description: Push back. See if they'll let you keep battling.

choices.label: Walk Away
choices.description: The terms aren't right. You're not giving up battles.

chapters.title: Bidding War
chapters.description: Word got out about the offer. Now other labels and platforms are reaching out. You've got options.

choices.label: Take the Best Offer
choices.description: Go with whoever's paying the most.

choices.label: Partner with a Battle Platform
choices.description: Stay in the culture. Partner with someone who gets it.

chapters.title: Label Life
chapters.description: You signed. The money hit. But now they want you in the studio when you should be prepping for battles.

choices.label: Prioritize the Music
choices.description: This is your new career. Battling was the come-up.

choices.label: Try to Balance Both
choices.description: Work twice as hard. Do both.

chapters.title: Counter Offer
chapters.description: They came back with a modified deal. Less money but you can keep battling with approval. They get right of first refusal on booking.

choices.label: Accept the Modified Deal
choices.description: This works. You keep your freedom and get paid.

endings.title: Stayed True
endings.description: You turned down the money to stay in battles. The culture respects it. The offers might come again.

endings.title: Walked Away
endings.description: You walked away from bad terms. Smart move. Other opportunities will come.

endings.title: Secured the Bag
endings.description: You got paid. Some people call it selling out. You call it getting what you're worth.

endings.title: Culture Partner
endings.description: You partnered with a battle platform. Getting paid while staying in the culture.

endings.title: Artist Now
endings.description: You transitioned to music. Battles are in your past. Mixed feelings in the culture about it.

endings.title: Stretched Thin
endings.description: You're doing both but neither at your best. Something's gotta give eventually.

endings.title: Best of Both Worlds
endings.description: You negotiated a deal that works. Money and freedom. This is how you play the game.

endings.title: Deal Fell Through
endings.description: You pushed too hard. They pulled the offer. Lesson learned about knowing when to take the deal.
